note: Languages and screens are the global pair index: index = languageIndex * screens.length + screenIndex. Add a language or a first-level screen here. kind is home, menu, or favorites. menuId is the side-menu row. picker is the exact native label in the interface-language list. chrome and content notes guide the locale review script.

screens.chrome: Menus, tabs, buttons, and the translation input placeholder. All chrome should match the interface language.
screens.content: Language-pair names (e.g. French/English, Francés/Inglés, Französisch/Englisch, Français/Anglais) are localized forms of the selected translation languages — that is correct, not mixed_locale. Do not flag typed source text. Numbers, emails, and URLs are fine in any language.

screens.chrome: Screen title, section headers, card titles, and navigation. Chrome should match the interface language.
screens.content: Ignore list names, word counts, and any word or sentence examples shown on cards. Those are user or catalog content and may be in any language.

screens.chrome: Header, toolbar, filters, and empty-state chrome. Chrome should match the interface language.
screens.content: Ignore every saved word, translation, and example sentence in the list. User content may be in any language and may ellipsize.

screens.chrome: Almost all visible text is chrome. Row labels, section headers, and the current interface-language value should match the interface language. Only the top of Settings is captured.
screens.content: Native language names in the interface-language row are allowlisted. Do not flag account email or version numbers.

screens.chrome: Screen title, filters, and empty-state text. Chrome should match the interface language.
screens.content: Ignore past queries and result snippets. Those are user history and may be in any language.

screens.chrome: Screen title, onboarding headline and description, input placeholder, and buttons (e.g. Next). Chrome should match the interface language.
screens.content: The onboarding may show a demo card with example sentences (e.g. "You can contact me any time." and its rephrasings) and an "AI Rephrase" label inside the illustration: that is sample content and may stay in English. Also ignore any text already typed in the rephrase field.
